profile.visual_desc: Muscular human male in a dark grey sleeveless tunic and green front sash. Equipped with dark arm guards, blue shin wrappings, and a blue headwrap.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Profile facing right. Face heavily obscured by deep shadows. A single glowing white eye sliver pierces the darkness. Features a brown headband and thick blue hair framing the face.
profile.weapon_desc: Thin katana-style longsword, wielded in a versatile single or double-handed grip.
profile.step1_ready: Upright stance facing down-right. Sword held vertically in front of the chest.
profile.step2_windup: Subtle backward weight shift, maintaining the vertical sword guard to coil energy.
profile.step3_impact: Explosive crouched lunge forward. A bright golden-yellow diagonal energy arc traces the sword's rapid downward swing from top-left to bottom-right.
profile.step4_finish: Stays in a deep crouch as the light trail fades, then extends the right arm to hold the blade horizontally.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The golden VFX arc in Frame 4 MUST precisely overlay the diagonal top-left to bottom-right sword swing trajectory.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation frames correctly mirror reference poses with consistent VFX alignment.
